classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary The main controller for the Colors demo application.
 * @description This controller orchestrates the entire Colors application, managing the dashboard widgets (grid, pie chart, bar chart),
 * handling real-time data updates, and demonstrating some of Neo.mjs's most advanced features.
 * It serves as a central hub for state management, cross-window communication, and the seamless drag-to-popup functionality.
 * This class is a key example of how to build a complex, interactive, and multi-window application.
 * @class Colors.view.ViewportController
 * @extends Neo.controller.Component
 * @see Neo.draggable.container.SortZone
 */

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Asks the backend for a batch, and answers null when none arrives before `backendDeadline`.
     * @description This is the RPC layer at work: the app worker calls the backend's `ColorService.read()` as if it
     * were a local method. A call on a socket that cannot connect never settles, so it races a deadline; a rejected
     * call and a remotes api that never registers count as no answer too.
     * @returns {Promise<Object|null>} The batch (`{summaryData, tableData}`), or null
     */
classData.summary: Asks the backend for a batch, and answers null when none arrives before `backendDeadline`.
classData.description: This is the RPC layer at work: the app worker calls the backend's ColorService.read() as if it were a local method. A call on a socket that cannot connect never settles, so it races a deadline; a rejected call and a remotes api that never registers count as no answer too.
classData.name: readFromBackend

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Fetches a new batch and hands it to the grid and the charts.
     * @description The batch comes from the backend (`readFromBackend()`). When the backend does not answer in
     * time, the state provider's `dataSource` switches to 'local', and this and every later batch come from
     * `Colors.service.ColorService` inside the app: the same call, answered without a network. A reload asks the
     * backend again.
     */
classData.summary: Fetches a new batch and hands it to the grid and the charts.
classData.description: The batch comes from the backend (readFromBackend()). When the backend does not answer in time, the state provider's dataSource switches to 'local', and this and every later batch come from Colors.service.ColorService inside the app: the same call, answered without a network. A reload asks the backend again.
classData.name: updateWidgets
